description: Use this when the user asks who is favoured in one game, by how much, or how the two sides compare for it. Returns the pre-game win probability and projected margin, the sportsbook spread and total with the market's vig-free chance and the model against the line, recent ATS form, the teams compared, leaders, form, meetings and the injury report; a Pro account also gets factor weights, absence costs, position matchups and ATS records. Needs a game_id from tonight_slate or find_game. Not for picks or betting advice: Keel Stats gives neither.

game_id.description: Numeric game ID (from tonight_slate, find_game or team_profile).

include_breakdown.description: Set true (requires Keel Stats Pro) to include model factor weights, player absence costs, position matchups, and ATS records. Defaults to true when signed in with Pro.

name: game_projection
title: Game Projection & Matchup Breakdown
